channel.description: Latest articles from The Hollywood Reporter Inc. (thr.com)

item.title: Michelle Randolph Is Having a Moment: ‘Scream 7,’ ‘Landman’ — And What’s Next
item.description: The actress is unpacking her big opening scene in the slasher film, performing her own stunts, what’s ahead for the third season of Taylor Sheridan’s hit show and her upcoming Christmas movie with Christopher Briney.

item.title: Box Office: ‘Hoppers’ Redeems Pixar in Bounding to Seminal $46M U.S. Win, ‘The Bride!’ Bombs With $7.3M
item.description: For once, Pixar didn't have to go on the defense as its new movie scored the biggest opening in nearly a decade for an original animated pic. Warner Bros.' Michael De Luca and Pamela Abdy were in the opposite position as Maggie Gyllenhaal's edgy film about Frankenstein's bride collapsed at the altar.

item.title: Chloé Zhao, Bowen Yang and ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ Honored at 2026 Unforgettable Awards
item.description: Daniel Dae Kim, Park Chan-wook, Lawrence Shou, Te Ao o Hinepehinga, Lloyd Lee Choi, Leenda Dong and Jet Tila were also honored at the event, which celebrates Asian and Pacific Islander excellence in film, TV and culture.

item.title: Inside the Star-Studded Opening of Zero Bond Las Vegas at Wynn (Exclusive)
item.description: Tom Brady, LeBron James, Kevin Costner, Gwyneth Paltrow, Mark Wahlberg, Taylor Sheridan and Jessica Alba were among the stars who helped celebrate the club's opening weekend.

item.title: ‘Sinners,’ ‘Adolescence’ Among MPSE Golden Reel Awards Winners
item.description: 'Frankenstein,' 'Zootopia 2' and 'Love, Death + Robots' also scored trophies at the awards show on Sunday.

item.title: ‘Sinners,’ ‘One Battle After Another’ Top Writers Guild Awards
item.description: 'The Pitt,' 'The Studio' and 'Dying for Sex' were among the TV winners at the Roy Wood Jr.-hosted ceremony, held Sunday night in New York.

item.title: Shots Fired at Rihanna and A$AP Rocky’s Home While She Was Inside
item.description: A woman has been taken into custody. It's unclear if the rapper and their three children were present at the time of the incident.

item.title: American Society of Cinematographers Awards: Michael Bauman Wins Film Prize for ‘One Battle After Another’
item.description: 'One Battle After Another' wins here ahead of what's considered a tight cinematography contest with 'Sinners' at the Oscars.
